name: auto-research
description: End-to-end auto-research in one interactive Claude Code session: ideation (vendored arxiv-recommender) -> you pick ONE seed (its venue + your refining notes) -> seed->HANDOFF conversion (KACE-grade work order) -> LOOP{ experiment+drafting, adversarial review (vendored paper-polishing), deterministic exit gate } -> ship a rigorous, reviewer-hardened paper draft + a FINAL-REPORT. A thin L0 state machine (spec/research.js, reproduced by commands/auto-research.md) orchestrates nested L1 subagent-orchestrators that reproduce the vendored specs; the vendored anti-fabrication freeze hook guards every number; long experiments detach and re-wake L0 via the asyncRewake Stop hook. One run pursues exactly one idea; re-run /auto-research for a fresh ideation gate.
